whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fulltoss Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.7★ reviews in Langar Toli, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online food orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, special menu highlights, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fulltoss

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Fulltoss Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and your strong 4.7★ rating showcase in Langar Toli. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur pricing integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
